an4.2:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatitoti vuccati
an4.2:1.3: ariyena bhikkhave sīlena asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatitoti vuccati
an4.2:1.4: ariyena bhikkhave samādhinā asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatitoti vuccati
an4.2:1.5: ariyāya bhikkhave paññāya asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatitoti vuccati
an4.2:1.6: ariyāya bhikkhave vimuttiyā asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinyā papatitoti vuccati
an4.2:1.7: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatitoti vuccati.
an4.2:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā apapatitoti vuccati
an4.2:2.3: ariyena bhikkhave sīlena samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā apapatitoti vuccati
an4.2:2.4: ariyena bhikkhave samādhinā samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā apapatitoti vuccati
an4.2:2.5: ariyāya bhikkhave paññāya samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā apapatitoti vuccati
an4.2:2.6: ariyāya bhikkhave vimuttiyā samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā apapatitoti vuccati
an4.2:2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā apapatitoti vuccatīti.
